svg.aria-label: H4 600-cell stereographically projected from S3 to R3, six frames at increasing Hopf rotation angle, showing curved great-circle edges
svg.title: H4 600-cell — stereographic projection with a 1-parameter SO(4) Hopf rotation
svg.desc: The H4 600-cell (120 vertices, 720 edges, recovered from the E8 root system via the H4 unimodular fold) stereographically projected from S³ to R³ at six increasing Hopf-rotation angles. Edges are curved great-circle arcs on S³, not straight chords. Generated deterministically by scripts/generate-gallery.ts from buildStereographic600CellEdges and so4RotationHopf.
svg.text: H4 600-cell — stereographic S³ → R³, Hopf rotation
